offlineSourceReconstruction.reduction: 2x2x2 optical-mass mean with conservative positive support
offlineSourceReconstruction.signedDistance: exact fine-support EDT reinitialized before conservative coarse resampling
offlineSourceReconstruction.runtimeStorage: discarded; final atlas remains the fixed coarse ABI

a.conservatism: magnitude is rounded toward zero after subtracting the voxel-cell circumradius

majorants.conservatism: maximum of authoritative density and exterior detail-class ceiling over maximum axis-scaled displaced support plus a cell-circumradius interpolation halo, then a one-voxel brick sampling halo

highIceMomentSidecar.alignment: byte-for-byte volume ordinals, offsets, and guard voxels match atlas; guards are RG=0

r.source: d_i = mass-conditioned authored fine density byte / 255; secondMoment = (1/8) * sum(d_i^2)
r.normalization: source density is bounded to [0, 1], and E[d^2] is conditioned to [coarseMean^2, coarseMean] after the authoritative occupancy floor before RG8 quantization

g.source: supportCount / 8 where sourceOccupied is the conditioned authored 96^3 positive-density mask

highIceMomentSidecar.supportContract: both channels are exactly zero outside final coarse support; no screen-space texture or noise is injected

guard.semantics: one clear texel on every face of every source tile; unused tail tiles are clear
guard.filtering: linear samples outside canonical [0,1] are isolated by the zero guard before clamping

r.source: the deterministic authored sourceDensity R8 field before 2x coarse reduction, block-mass-conditioned to the final authoritative coarse R byte

g.source: the exact conditioned 48^3 highIceMoments.coverage byte replicated across each corresponding 2^3 fine child block

b.source: E[(conditioned fine density / 255)^2] over the eight children, quantized once and replicated

a.source: the final conditioned fine material support bit (255 iff conditioned R is positive), encoded per child

supportSemantics.field: each source is the authored high-ice condensate density on its complete fine lattice
supportSemantics.positive: R is conditioned source density; G is parent support coverage; B is conditioned E[rho^2]; A is conditioned fine material occupancy (R > 0)
supportSemantics.clear: R retains authored sub-threshold density bytes for clear fine children while their final coarse parent is supported, then conditions block mass exactly to the authoritative coarse R; sidecar moments use these same conditioned bytes
supportSemantics.guard: guard and unused voxels are exactly zero in all four channels and are not source support
supportSemantics.parent: RGBA are zero when the final reduced coarse parent is unsupported; supported parents retain G and B across all eight children
supportSemantics.reconstruction: the 48^3 macro density and RG8 moments are independent reductions of the same authored source bytes; RGBA source blocks retain density, coverage, second moment, and occupancy in one sample

highIceSourceAtlas.alignment: slot offsets and source IDs are deterministic; source tile bytes are copied row-major as z,y,x

denseAssetBudget.policy: keep the rgba8 3D texture ABI, append IDs, and tile bounded representative exemplars across manifest-derived X/Z slots

forbiddenSubstitutions: coverage used as a topology selector
post-density masks used to carve clear cells or system boundaries
periodic analytic fields used to synthesize cellular or street structure

densitySemantics.ceiling: detail-class maximumExteriorDensity is a hard extinction-density ceiling

orderedRules: ice-sedimentation when permitted and ice >= 0.62 and detail >= 0.60
ice-fibre when permitted and (ice >= 0.56 or detail >= 0.72)

signedDistanceContract.normal: normalized central difference of decoded atlas.a in canonical voxel coordinates

displacementContract.protectedBaseScale: for downward normals, mix downwardDisplacementScale to 1 across the declared base feather; otherwise 1
displacementContract.domainContinuation: clamp the lookup coordinate to this volume's texel domain, add length(canonicalPosition - clamp(canonicalPosition, 0, 1)) * (volumeResolution - 1) to decoded signed distance, and use clamped G/B attributes
displacementContract.ownerBounds: inflate visible owner bounds by visibleOwnerBoundsInflationCanonical and traversal bounds by traversalOwnerBoundsInflationCanonical before interval construction

order: sample RGBA even when R is zero
decode signed distance and derive its normal
select the volume-permitted exterior class from G and B
evaluate interior and exterior density before local optical transport
apply the same combined density in lighting and view transmittance paths
compositionContract.forbiddenEarlyExit: Do not reject macroDensity == 0 before evaluating exterior support.

storageGuards.packedZPadding: remains empty density with positive saturated signed distance
storageGuards.trilinearIsolation: sampleTransform addresses texel centers and paddingZ prevents adjacent-volume bleed
storageGuards.exteriorFaceContinuation: canonical coordinates outside the storage cube use explicit per-volume clamping and signed-distance continuation; never allow hardware filtering into an adjacent packed volume

accelerationContract.source: max(authoritative density, exterior class density ceiling inside maximum displaced support)
accelerationContract.traversalRule: a zero majorant is the only value that may skip both macro and exterior procedural density

provenance.method: deterministic formation-manifold volumes with 2x conservative protected-Cu source reconstruction: hierarchical thermal trees, reconstructible sedimenting ice trajectories, finite multi-lobed cellular colonies, harmonic inversion/frontal boundaries with dry-air intrusions, wave lenses, roll circulation, and fragmented boundary-layer shreds
